new_declarations.scope: Derived helper for the corrected even translate trapezoid already defined on main. The literal printed psi remains a separate QUESTION.
new_declarations.statement: theorem hcheck_trapL9_eq (d : ℝ) (hd0 : 0 < d) (hd1 : d ≤ 1 / 4) (h : ℤ) (hh : h ≠ 0) : hcheck (fun t => (trapL9 (4 * d) t : ℂ)) h = 1 / ((d : ℂ) * (-(2 * π * Complex.I * h)) ^ 2) * (1 - Complex.exp (-(2 * π * Complex.I * h) * d) - Complex.exp (-(2 * π * Complex.I * h) * (1 / 2 - d)) + Complex.exp (-(2 * π * Complex.I * h) * (1 / 2)))

new_declarations.name: LeanLab.ExceptionalSet.U1539.KaracubaSplit.S1CaseSupply672.leaf_s1_monotone_saving
new_declarations.source: P0082 pages 370 and 371 and Karacuba 1971 page 244
new_declarations.scope: Derived singleton first derivative extension. Karacuba prints derivative orders at least two. The extension is not attributed as his literal theorem.
new_declarations.statement: private theorem leaf_s1_monotone_saving : ∀ θ Θ Θ₀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < 1 → 0 < Θ → Θ < θ → θ < Θ₀ → Θ₀ < 1 → ∃ B c N₀ : ℝ, 0 < B ∧ 0 < c ∧ 0 < N₀ ∧ ∀ N : ℕ, N₀ ≤ (N : ℝ) → ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (k : ℕ), 3 ≤ k → (∃ U : Set ℝ, IsOpen U ∧ Set.Icc (N : ℝ) (2 * N) ⊆ U ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ k f U) → (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (N : ℝ) (2 * N), |iteratedDeriv k f x / k.factorial| ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (-(Θ₀ * k))) → δ * k ≤ 1 → (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (N : ℝ) (2 * N), (N : ℝ) ^ (-(θ * (1 : ℕ))) ≤ |iteratedDeriv 1 f x / (1 : ℕ).factorial| ∧ |iteratedDeriv 1 f x / (1 : ℕ).factorial| ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (-(Θ * (1 : ℕ)))) → ((∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (N : ℝ) (2 * N), 0 < iteratedDeriv 1 f x) ∨ (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (N : ℝ) (2 * N), iteratedDeriv 1 f x < 0)) → ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc N (2 * N), eC (f n)‖ ≤ B * (N : ℝ) ^ (1 - c / (k : ℝ) ^ 2)
